morphology.pattern_note: 外来角色名，整词记忆；不是由马来语词根和词缀组成。双写 ff 不应据此解释为马来语中的长辅音。

senses.zh_definition: 路飞：专名，通常指尾田荣一郎漫画《航海王》及其改编作品的主人公蒙奇·D·路飞，草帽海贼团船长。
senses.en_definition: Luffy, usually Monkey D. Luffy, the protagonist of Eiichiro Oda's One Piece and captain of the Straw Hat Pirates.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang lazimnya merujuk Monkey D. Luffy, watak utama One Piece karya Eiichiro Oda dan kapten kumpulan lanun Topi Jerami.
senses.nuances: 规范书写为 Luffy。此处是专名说明，不是 DBP 普通词释义；输入没有上下文，因此不能排除同名账号或昵称。以下搭配为自然表达，未经语料频率统计。[ONE PIECE 官方角色介绍](https://one-piece.com/character/luffy/index.html)

dual_scenarios.context: 文化报道 / 作品介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Watak Luffy dalam One Piece dikenali sebagai kapten kumpulan lanun Topi Jerami.
dual_scenarios.zh: 《航海王》中的路飞以草帽海贼团船长的身份为人熟知。
dual_scenarios.en: Luffy in One Piece is known as the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak beli patung Luffy tu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu membeli patung Luffy itu.
dual_scenarios.en: I want to buy that Luffy figure.
spoken_features: nak：mahu 或 hendak 的口语对应形式
口语常省略 membeli 的 meN- 前缀

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak beli patung Luffy tu lah. Kau dah tengok?
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu membeli patung Luffy itu. Awak sudah melihatnya?
messages.zh: 我想买那个路飞手办。你看过了吗？
messages.en: I want that Luffy figure. Have you seen it?

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, comel je! Tapi tengok harga dulu lah.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, patung itu comel! Tetapi lihat harganya dahulu.
messages.zh: 看过啦，挺可爱的！不过先看看价格吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's cute! But check the price first.

etymology.historical_story: Luffy belongs to the naming world of Eiichiro Oda's One Piece, whose manga serialization began in 1997. Malay speakers can use the character's established Roman-letter name when discussing the series. This is a proper name used across languages, not a Malay derivation. Its spelling alone supplies no reliable explanation of the creator's naming intention. [Official series history](https://one-piece.com/about/index.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Luffy → 路飞 → 草帽船长；把名字和草帽形象一起记，不拆成马来语词缀。
